answers.question: Where does this case stand, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: At the landlord approval gate, on hold. The landlord has not replied since January. Notes claim an approved £500+VAT quote, but nothing in the landlord's own words supports it. The route (our contractor or their own) is unknown.

answers.question: What is the next action, for whom, via which channel?
answers.answer: SMS to the landlord asking which route, reply by 17 March (second channel after the earlier email); email update to the tenant; follow-up set for 17 March.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision?
answers.answer: Not yet. This is a routine job and the landlord is being chased. If there is still no reply by 17 March, escalate P3 to maintenance.

tickets.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
